A '''501st Legion clone trooper''' was stationed in a captured [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] tried to get back [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]], but [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Pong Krell/Legends|Krell]] said no. Later, he reported that [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase's]] fighter was launched unexpectedly and nearly destroyed [[Hangar 9-4/Legends|Hangar 9-4]].<ref name="pod" />
